items.text: Lamar Jackson listed IN for Sunday after full practices and coach confirmation he will play vs Bills following multi-week ankle absence.
items.why: Full participant all week; coach Jesse Minter: 'We do think we'll have Lamar this week'; no designation.
items.implication: Unlocks Ravens offense and Zay Flowers upside in high-total spot vs BUF.
items.opportunity: Increased pass volume and designed runs for Jackson; Flowers route share spike historically with Lamar.

items.text: Emeka Egbuka OUT (concussion/foot); Levitan took him out in projections with fallout noted.
items.why: Ruled out Friday; cleared concussion but foot keeps him sidelined second straight week. Coach confirmed.
items.implication: TB WR depth thins; targets to other Bucs receivers or TE.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes for remaining TB pass-catchers.

items.text: Broncos ruled out RB RJ Harvey; WR Jaylen Waddle listed questionable vs Chiefs.
items.why: Official Friday report; Harvey knee, Waddle chest.
items.implication: DEN backfield opportunity shifts; Waddle risky start.
items.opportunity: Carries/snaps to other DEN RBs (e.g. J.K. Dobbins or committee); Waddle routes if active limited.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley has no injury designation and is good to go; WR DeVonta Smith ruled out along with Dontayvion Wicks.
items.why: Official Friday injury report; Barkley cleared, Smith/Wicks out.
items.implication: Barkley full workload expected; Eagles pass game thinned, more Goedert/targets elsewhere.
items.opportunity: Barkley goal-line and volume secure; reverse prior handcuff lean.
items.conflict: Berry ranks Barkley as HATE/RB20 on usage concerns despite clear.

items.text: Rashee Rice listed IN; expected to play after recent return trajectory.
items.why: ETR IN list; full participant Friday reports.
items.implication: KC WR hierarchy stabilizes with Rice active alongside Worthy/others.
items.opportunity: Rice target share and red-zone role resumes.

items.text: Carnell Tate (shoulder) and Tyjae Spears (knee) OUT; Levitan projections updated for fallout.
items.why: ETR and Schefter official outs; no practice week for Tate.
items.implication: TEN WR/RB targets consolidate to Ridley/Pollard or others.
items.opportunity: Pollard volume up; remaining WRs route share increase.

items.text: Adam Levitan taking AJ Brown (knee) OUT in projections as of Friday despite Q tag; notes knee history and fallout linked.
items.why: Knee flared; Levitan: taken out with Egbuka/Tate/Spears; historical knee issues.
items.implication: NE pass game shifts; Henderson also Q but volume opportunity if Brown sits.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining Pats WRs/RBs if Brown inactive.
items.conflict: Still officially Q; could be GTD.

items.text: Matthew Berry LOVES Zay Flowers as his WR5 this week; Lamar expected back unlocks him (48% route target rate historically with Lamar).
items.why: Lamar return + track-meet Bills-Ravens total; Flowers heavy usage with Lamar.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/routes/red-zone with Jackson under center.

items.text: Brian Thomas Jr. dropped to Konata Mumpfield/Troy Franklin tier in ETR Wk 8 projections despite 87-1282-10 rookie season; major tier drop after 20 games.
items.why: Projection data shows sharp decline in expected output.
items.implication: Fringe play; sell or sit in many formats.
items.opportunity: Reduced projected targets/routes/snaps relative to early career.

items.text: After two-touchdown outing, Levitan would try to sell Quinshon Judkins; ETR clip explains why (role/usage sustainability concerns).
items.why: TD spike not fully supported by underlying opportunity/role long-term.
items.opportunity: Monitor snap/carry share vs committee risk (e.g. Sampson).

items.text: Levitan: Josh Jacobs going Ashton Jeanty route of strong fantasy value via high-value touches (3 carries inside-5 + 13 targets in two games post-suspension); efficiency bonus.
items.why: Inside-5 carries and target volume driving value independent of pure efficiency.
items.implication: Reliable RB starter/ROS asset; parallel to Jeanty profile.

items.text: Berry HATES Jaylen Waddle this week (WR30); production lagging and Chiefs allowed just one WR TD all season (to JSN).
items.why: Tough KC secondary + recent production issues; now also Q with chest.
items.opportunity: Low expected targets/routes vs elite coverage.

items.text: Berry LOVES Derrick Henry (RB6), Chase Brown (RB8), Josh Jacobs (RB11) for favorable run defenses and TD upside; also likes Breece Hall/Braelon Allen vs LV.
items.why: Matchups vs run-weak defenses; Henry history vs BUF, Brown TD regression, Jacobs vs CAR.
items.implication: Strong RB starts; volume and scoring spots.

items.text: Berry HATES Saquon Barkley (RB20) on usage concerns despite clear, Tony Pollard (RB21), and Omarion Hampton (RB34) still seeking role.
items.why: Barkley usage wariness post-injury/context; Pollard underdog spot; Hampton limited role.
items.opportunity: Monitor actual snap/carry share for Barkley; Hampton depth-chart stagnant.
items.conflict: Barkley fully cleared/no designation per Schefter/Rapoport/ETR; usage data may still support.
